LVGLab 0.3.0 adds SquareLine components, a much more capable simulator, alignment tools and memory statistics.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `LVGLab-0.3.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.3.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.3.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.3.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

Unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows); no installation needed. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- **Components**: reusable widget groups, edited like a screen and placed with the Component widget. Exported like
  SquareLine (`ui_<Name>_create()`, `ui_comp_get_child()`, `UI_COMP_<NAME>_<CHILD>`, create hooks) and imported
  from `components/*.ecomp`
- **Simulator**: screen load animations, live test data for gauges and numeric labels (wave or widest values),
  and recording as an animated GIF
- **Alignment**: Ctrl+click multi-selection, align and distribute, snap lines to neighbors
- **Statistics** in the toolbar: estimated RAM and flash, widget counts
- **Font check**: warning when a text uses characters its font does not contain
- Saving copies all assets into `assets/` next to the project; autosave with highlighted timeline steps
- "Add image…" directly in image fields and a quick "Background image" style
- "Export library" sits in the menu bar

## Fixed

- SquareLine flex alignments: Center and End were swapped on import
- Gradients on rounded widgets were drawn as rectangles

## Known limitations

- SquareLine animations and events are not imported yet.
- Events of objects inside components are not exported.
- LVGL 9 is not supported.
